install.rowPrompt: No app store needed. It opens in its own window.
install.rowIos: Add it to your Home Screen from the Share menu.
install.rowMac: Add it to the Dock from Safari's File menu.
install.installedDescription: Open {name} from your home screen or app list.

ios.title: Install on iPhone or iPad
ios.intro: Add {name} to your Home Screen to open it like an app.
ios.step1: Tap Share in the browser toolbar. Don't see it? Tap first.
ios.step2: Scroll down and choose Add to Home Screen.
ios.step3: Tap Add. {name} now opens from your Home Screen.

mac.title: Add to Dock
mac.intro: Open {name} from the Dock, in its own window.
mac.step1: In Safari's menu bar, choose File → Add to Dock…

offlinePage.title: You're offline
offlinePage.description: We can't reach the server right now. Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.
offlinePage.stillOffline: Still no connection. Try again in a moment.
offlinePage.autoReload: This page reloads by itself once you're back online.
offlinePage.tipDrafts: Quotes you were editing are kept as drafts on this device. Pick up where you left off when you're back.
offlinePage.tipConnection: Saving, emailing and downloading PDFs need a connection.
offlinePage.serverDescription: Your device is online, but the server isn't responding. It may be restarting after an update.
offlinePage.serverStill: The server still isn't responding. Try again in a moment.
offlinePage.serverAutoRetry: We'll keep checking and reload this page when it's back.
